title: RoboProbe SUT profile
description: Robot-stack configuration under test (docs/10 §4, docs/11 `sut_profiles`): kinematic2d controller constants, a Nav2 parameter set, or an empty analytic benchmark profile. Domain configuration, never env-driven (docs/27 §1). The file name must be `<id>.yaml`.

provisional.description: Top-level `config` keys whose values await verification (e.g. by T-091); rejected when loading strictly.

relative_path.description: Repository- or package-relative POSIX path; no absolute paths, no `..` segments.

param_path.description: Dotted parameter path with optional list indices, e.g. `velocity_smoother.ros__parameters.max_velocity[0]`.

model_file.description: kinematic2d model file holding the robot, controller and planner constants (T-029).

perception_model_file.description: Perception degradation constants for depth simulation (T-034); defaults from settings when omitted.

gain_overrides.description: Constants overridden for this profile, keyed by their dotted path in `model_file`.

base_nav2_params.description: Package-relative Nav2 parameter file the overlay is applied to.

speed_param_paths.description: Nav2 parameters set to the P1 speed value (docs/10 §4).

nav2_overrides.description: Nested Nav2 parameters deep-merged over `base_nav2_params` for this profile.
